description.narrative: Subscription of USD 25 million to JSC Georgia Capital's ("GCAP" or "the Issuer") 5-year, USD 150 million Sustainability-Linked Bond ("SLB") to be listed and traded on the Georgian Stock Exchange. The SLB complies with the International Capital Markets Association's ("ICMA") Sustainability-Linked Bond Principles, as confirmed by an independent second-party opinion. The SLB proceeds will be primarily used to refinance GCAP's exiting Eurobonds and to maintain a liquidity buffer. The SLB that adheres by the ICMA standards of sustainable finance is the first instrument of its kind to be issued in the Caucasus. Notably, the SLB also marks the largest corporate bond issuance in Georgia.
